notes: This file is the single source of defaults for scripts/run-newman.js.
Every value here can be overridden without editing this file:
CLI flags win over environment variables, which win over this file.
NEWMAN_ENV picks dev or prod (environments.<name> above).
BASE_URL overrides the baseUrl variable from the environment file.
NEWMAN_DATA_FILE overrides defaultDataFile; empty means no data file.
override their matching values here. See .env.example and docs/SETUP.md.
